idea: Colors & shapes (KITCHEN, snack time): a big round cookie rolls across Baby Jimmy's high-chair tray by surprise ('Wow! Look! A circle!'); he traces it 'round and round' (copy-me: draw a circle in the air); then a yellow cheese SQUARE ('one, two, three, four sides!') and a sandwich TRIANGLE ('one, two, three sides!'); all three stand in a row and Jimmy asks the viewer 'Where is the triangle? Hmm?' (pause) – 'There it is!'; lesson 'Shapes are everywhere!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now with all three shapes in a row and a bye-bye wave.
lesson: Circle, square and triangle – shapes are everywhere, even in our snacks.
calendar: Tuesday slot 1 – Colors & shapes (first shapes episode; basic shapes circle/square/triangle).

variety.outfit: Jimmy HOME (light blue onesie, matches the sheet; snack time, not cooking – CHEF hat would hide his curls)
variety.why_not_jimmys_room: Jimmy's room is covered with star shapes – confusing for a shapes lesson; the kitchen is calm and shows shapes in everyday things.

characters: Jimmy (HOME): BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue short-sleeve onesie with a small yellow star, barefoot.

supporting_objects.circle: a big plain round golden cookie (no chips, no icing)
supporting_objects.square: one thick firm square slice of yellow cheese
supporting_objects.triangle: a white bread sandwich cut corner to corner (thin cheese layer)

setting: KITCHEN: a bright family kitchen with white cabinets and light-wood counters, a pastel yellow fridge covered with children's crayon drawings and fruit magnets, a round white table on a round pastel rainbow rug with two adult chairs, a blue baby high chair and a pink baby high chair, a fruit bowl, a yellow hanging lamp, and a window with small green plants.

learning.goal: Name three basic shapes – circle, square, triangle – and find them in everyday things.
learning.shown_how: Real snacks, big beside Jimmy's face: a round cookie (circle, rolls in), a yellow cheese square, a white bread triangle sandwich; then all three in a neat row on the tray (left to right circle, square, triangle).
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:20 'Where is the triangle? Hmm?' (finger on chin, question boing) + 0:20-0:22 humming pause → 0:22 'There it is! The triangle! Yay!' (Jimmy points at it and claps)
learning.copy_me: 0:03-0:07 'Draw it with me, round and round!' – kids draw a circle in the air with a finger (Jimmy traces the cookie's edge)
learning.fact_check: Square = four sides, triangle = three sides (correct); exactly one of each shape on screen; circle is a flat round disc, square has equal sides, triangle has three straight sides; items appear in song order.
learning.modeling: Jimmy looks carefully, names each shape and counts its sides; no wrong choice to correct.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, everyday snacks toddlers know, bright calm kitchen, one baby, big face and big shapes.

fun_mechanics: surprise hook: a cookie rolls in by itself
copy-me: draw a circle in the air
interactive pause: Where is the triangle?

story_order.cheese square: shot 1 absent · shot 2 appears in his hand · shots 3-5 present
story_order.triangle sandwich: shots 1-2 absent · shot 3 appears in his hands · shots 4-5 present

shots.role: HOOK – a round cookie rolls in, Jimmy gasps 'Wow! Look! A circle!', then traces it round and round
item 2: yellow cheese SQUARE beside his face, taps four corners
shots.frame: f2 r2 (r0 stuck pending in the queue; r1 had TWO cheese squares)

shots.role: item 3: white bread TRIANGLE sandwich, taps three corners
review + question: all three in a row, 'Where is the triangle? Hmm?', points and claps
LOOP ENDING – edit of the hook frame, three shapes in a row, bye-bye wave
